fact: The Countdown to 2030 / Global Financing Facility synthesis report analyses routinely reported national health facility data from DHIS2 for 2019-2024, with facility reports received from districts across the country.
The report gives national completeness of monthly facility reporting in DHIS2 as 99% of expected reports in 2024 (93% in 2019), with 99% of districts at or above 90% completeness in 2024.

The Global Fund case study says the Government of Zambia and partners have strengthened the national health management information system for routine reporting, a DHIS2-based system the Global Fund supports with upgrades and maintenance.
The Global Fund case study says approximately 90% of health facilities use the national DHIS2 platform for integrated disease surveillance and response reporting.

The Ministry of Health's ZM-Core FHIR guide defines a facility profile for exchanging health information across systems, carrying identifiers issued by the Master Facility List, HMIS, DHIS2, SmartCare, eLMIS and iHRIS.
